{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "Prompt: Create a clean, modern, ProductHunt-inspired static landing page using Astro for a crowdfunding consulting service called \"LaunchFund Studio\". This is NOT a full app, no backend, no database, no login, no payments, no API integration, only a beautiful static marketing website with mock/sample content. Theme should be mostly light, minimal, premium, friendly, and startup-focused, with a dark mode toggle in the header that switches the visual theme. Website Goal: convince startup founders, creators, nonprofits, and indie makers to book a crowdfunding strategy call. Overall Style: inspired by ProductHunt launch pages and startup directory cards: white background, soft orange accents, rounded cards, subtle shadows, clean typography, small badges, testimonial cards, ranking-style sections, launch metrics, community feel. Use Astro components, simple CSS, responsive layout, and static content only. Pages/Sections: 1. Sticky Header: logo text \"LaunchFund Studio\", nav links: Services, Process, Results, Pricing, FAQ, CTA button \"Plan My Campaign\", dark/light toggle button with icon. 2. Hero Section: left side badge \"Crowdfunding Strategy for Founders\", headline \"Turn Your Big Idea Into a Funded Launch\", subheadline explaining campaign positioning, rewards, pre-launch audience building, and launch page optimization. CTA buttons: \"Get Campaign Roadmap\" and \"See Sample Results\". Right side: ProductHunt-style launch card mockup showing a campaign ranking, upvotes, funding progress, creator avatar placeholders, and tags like Hardware, Education, Social Impact. 3. Trust Strip: small stats cards with mock numbers: \"$8.4M+ Guided Funding\", \"120+ Campaigns Advised\", \"38 Countries\", \"4.9/5 Founder Rating\". 4. Problem Section: headline \"Most Campaigns Do Not Fail Because The Idea Is Bad\" with 3 simple cards: unclear positioning, weak pre-launch list, confusing reward tiers. 5. Services Section: six cards: Campaign Audit, Launch Positioning, Reward Strategy, Landing Page Copy, Email Sequence Planning, Press & Community Playbook. Keep it static and simple. 6. Featured Launch Blueprint Section: ProductHunt-inspired layout with a large featured card: \"30-Day Prelaunch Sprint\" including checklist items, mock progress bars, and a small \"Featured\" badge. 7. Process Section: 4 steps in a timeline: Discover, Shape the Offer, Build Launch Assets, Launch Week Support. 8. Results Section: mock case study cards only, no real companies: \"EcoBottle Kit - 312% funded\", \"MakerDesk Pro - $184k raised\", \"StudyPods - 9,800 waitlist signups\". Each card should look like a launch listing with upvote-style number, category pill, and short outcome. 9. Pricing Section: simple 3 static pricing cards: Starter Audit, Launch Sprint, Full Campaign Advisory. Mention \"sample pricing\" or \"starting from\". Include CTA buttons but they can be normal links. 10. Testimonials Section: founder quote cards with avatars using initials, all fictional. 11. FAQ Section: accordion-style visual is okay but can be static or simple JS, questions about when to start, who it is for, Kickstarter/Indiegogo/general crowdfunding, deliverables, and whether funding is guaranteed. Clearly say results are not guaranteed. 12. Final CTA Banner: \"Ready to launch with more confidence?\" button \"Start With a Campaign Audit\". 13. Footer: logo, short description, links, social-style text links, copyright. Design Requirements: light mode first, orange/amber ProductHunt-like accent (#ff6154 or #ff7a1a), off-white backgrounds, cards, rounded corners, clean startup SaaS typography, subtle gradients, no heavy animations, simple hover states, responsive mobile-first. Dark mode should change background/cards/text nicely but still keep orange accents. Use mock data inside components, no external services, no forms that submit anywhere, no authentication, no server code. Deliver as a static Astro landing page with organized components and clean reusable sections.",
 "judge": {
  "model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8",

  "request_model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8:novita",
  "provider": "novita",
  "pinned_on": "2026-10-09",
  "temperature": 0,
  "max_tokens": 1024,
  "rubric_id": "rva1:mean(visual,query,asset)"
 }
}

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Use temperature zero and bind the model/provider request and artifact revision; mask absent or mismatched deployment/response revision. Version-aware judge endpoint validation is staged.
